title: Italy holds high-stakes referendum on judiciary reform
summary: Italy’s conservative premier, Giorgia Meloni, faces a pivotal political test in a two-day referendum on judicial reform that started on Sunday, a vote that has transformed into a broader judgment on her leadership at home and abroad. If passed, the reform would the "biggest overhaul of the judiciary since World War II", FRANCE 24's Seema Gupta said, reporti…
